title: XREAL AURA Is Here: Meet Seven Made With Unity Titles
summary: See which Made With Unity games are launching on XREAL AURA glasses, hear from the studios behind them, and learn how to start building for Android XR.
body_markdown:
Hey there developers,


**XREAL AURA has officially[launched](https://cloud.google.com/blog/products/chrome-enterprise/step-in-to-a-new-dimension-with-xreal-aura-a-first-of-its-kind-wired-xr-glasses) !** It’s the first pair of wired XR glasses powered by Android XR, and it brings immersive gaming, mixed reality, and everyday utility into a lightweight form factor you can take anywhere.


When we[announced Unity’s support for XREAL AURA](https://unity.com/blog/unity-android-xr-wired-glasses-support) back in June, we couldn’t wait to see what you’d build. Read on to meet seven[Made With Unity](https://unity.com/made-with-unity) titles launching on XREAL AURA, and hear from the studios behind them.


There’s more on the way, too. With Unity 6.7 and[Unity 7 on the horizon](https://unity.com/releases/unity-7) , we’re continuing to invest in tools that make building for Android XR faster and easier. Get the full rundown of the latest Android XR features in our[newest Discussions post](https://discussions.unity.com/t/time-to-build-for-xreal-aura-with-android-xr/1740578) .
